rejected_ja: Rejected (却下). Round Japanese vermilion seal.
sealed_ja: Sealed (封印). Round Japanese vermilion seal.
on_hold_ja: On hold (保留). Japanese vermilion seal based on the completed design.
on_hold_en: On hold (ON HOLD). English rubber stamp based on the DONE design.
handle_with_care_ja: Handle with care (取扱注意). Open hands holding a large box inside a square border.
handle_with_care_en: Handle with care (HANDLE WITH CARE). Open hands holding a large box inside a square border.
shirangana_ja: A playful 'How should I know?' (しらんがな), in Kansai dialect. Square border, exclamation mark and white-outlined red lettering.
nandeyanen_ja: A playful 'What the heck?' or 'Why?!' (なんでやねん), in Kansai dialect. Large question mark and white-outlined red lettering.
hanamaru_ja: Excellent / a job well done. A Japanese praise mark with rounded flower petals and a central spiral; no main lettering.
smile_ja: A cheerful smile. Original smiling face inside a flower outline; no main lettering.
keep_going_ja: Keep trying / let's do our best (がんばりましょう). Large encouragement lettering in a cherry-blossom petal border.
well_done_ja: Very well done (たいへんよくできました). Large Japanese praise lettering in a cherry-blossom petal border.
physical_checked_ja: Physical item checked (現物確認). Japanese vermilion seal for visual marking of an in-person check.
do_not_remove_ja: Do not take outside / keep on premises (門外不出). Japanese vermilion seal.
confidential_ja: Confidential / secret (秘密／㊙). Japanese vermilion seal.
confidential_en: Confidential (CONFIDENTIAL). English lettering in a vermilion stamp design.
unread_en: Unread (UNREAD). English lettering in a square stamp design.
read_en: Read (READ). English lettering in a square stamp design.
copy_paste_only_ja: Only copied and pasted (コピペしただけ). Japanese lettering in a square stamp design.
copy_paste_only_en: Only copied and pasted (COPY & PASTE ONLY). English rubber stamp.
wanted_ja: Wanted / I'd like this (欲しい…). Japanese lettering in a square stamp design.
keep_secret_ja: Keep this secret / do not tell others (他言無用). Japanese vermilion seal.
fail_ja: Fail / did not pass (不合格). Round Japanese vermilion seal.
pass_ja: Pass (合格). Round Japanese vermilion seal.
